<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:480px;height:480px;overflow:hidden;background:#0e0e12}
canvas{display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d');
c.width=c.height=480;
const G=20,C=480/G,S=8;
let snake,dir,nd,food,score,best=0,alive,started,tick,frame;

function init(){
  snake=[];for(let i=2;i>=0;i--)snake.push({x:6+i,y:12});
  dir={x:1,y:0};nd={x:1,y:0};
  score=0;alive=true;started=false;tick=0;frame=0;
  placeFood();
}

function placeFood(){
  let fx,fy;
  do{fx=Math.random()*C|0;fy=Math.random()*C|0}
  while(snake.some(s=>s.x===fx&&s.y===fy));
  food={x:fx,y:fy};
}

function step(){
  if(!alive||!started)return;
  dir=nd;
  const h={x:snake[0].x+dir.x,y:snake[0].y+dir.y};
  if(h.x<0||h.x>=C||h.y<0||h.y>=C||snake.some(s=>s.x===h.x&&s.y===h.y)){
    alive=false;best=Math.max(best,score);return;
  }
  snake.unshift(h);
  if(h.x===food.x&&h.y===food.y){score++;placeFood()}
  else snake.pop();
}

function draw(){
  // Background
  x.fillStyle='#0e0e12';x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);

  // Subtle grid
  x.strokeStyle='#18181f';x.lineWidth=0.5;
  for(let i=0;i<=C;i++){
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(i*G,0);x.lineTo(i*G,480);x.stroke();
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(0,i*G);x.lineTo(480,i*G);x.stroke();
  }

  // Food glow
  const pulse=Math.sin(frame*0.08)*0.3+0.7;
  const grd=x.createRadialGradient(food.x*G+G/2,food.y*G+G/2,2,food.x*G+G/2,food.y*G+G/2,G*1.2);
  grd.addColorStop(0,`rgba(232,106,58,${0.25*pulse})`);
  grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(232,106,58,0)');
  x.fillStyle=grd;x.fillRect(food.x*G-G/2,food.y*G-G/2,G*2,G*2);

  // Food
  x.fillStyle='#e86a3a';
  x.beginPath();x.arc(food.x*G+G/2,food.y*G+G/2,G/2-2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();

  // Snake
  snake.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const t=i/snake.length;
    const r=Math.round(62-t*20),g=Math.round(207-t*60),b=Math.round(142-t*40);
    x.fillStyle=`rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
    const pad=i===0?1:2;
    const rad=i===0?6:4;
    roundRect(s.x*G+pad,s.y*G+pad,G-pad*2,G-pad*2,rad);
  });

  // Snake eyes
  if(snake.length){
    const h=snake[0],cx=h.x*G+G/2,cy=h.y*G+G/2;
    const ox=dir.x*3,oy=dir.y*3;
    x.fillStyle='#0e0e12';
    x.beginPath();x.arc(cx+ox-3*dir.y,cy+oy+3*dir.x,2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
    x.beginPath();x.arc(cx+ox+3*dir.y,cy+oy-3*dir.x,2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  }

  // Score
  x.fillStyle='#5a5a6e';x.font='bold 13px monospace';x.textAlign='left';
  x.fillText('SCORE '+score,12,22);
  x.textAlign='right';x.fillText('BEST '+best,468,22);

  // Start prompt
  if(!started&&alive){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(14,14,18,0.55)';x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
    x.fillStyle='#c8c8d4';x.font='bold 22px monospace';x.textAlign='center';
    x.fillText('SNAKE',240,210);
    x.fillStyle='#6a6a7e';x.font='14px monospace';
    x.fillText('press any key to start',240,240);
  }

  // Game over
  if(!alive){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(14,14,18,0.7)';x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
    x.fillStyle='#e86a3a';x.font='bold 22px monospace';x.textAlign='center';
    x.fillText('GAME OVER',240,210);
    x.fillStyle='#6a6a7e';x.font='14px monospace';
    x.fillText('score: '+score+'   press R to restart',240,240);
  }
}

function roundRect(rx,ry,rw,rh,rr){
  x.beginPath();
  x.moveTo(rx+rr,ry);x.lineTo(rx+rw-rr,ry);x.quadraticCurveTo(rx+rw,ry,rx+rw,ry+rr);
  x.lineTo(rx+rw,ry+rh-rr);x.quadraticCurveTo(rx+rw,ry+rh,rx+rw-rr,ry+rh);
  x.lineTo(rx+rr,ry+rh);x.quadraticCurveTo(rx,ry+rh,rx,ry+rh-rr);
  x.lineTo(rx,ry+rr);x.quadraticCurveTo(rx,ry,rx+rr,ry);
  x.closePath();x.fill();
}

function loop(){
  frame++;
  if(alive&&started){tick++;if(tick>=S){tick=0;step()}}
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(['arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','w','a','s','d'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();
  if(!alive){if(k==='r')init();return}
  if(!started){started=true}
  const map={
    arrowup:{x:0,y:-1},w:{x:0,y:-1},
    arrowdown:{x:0,y:1},s:{x:0,y:1},
    arrowleft:{x:-1,y:0},a:{x:-1,y:0},
    arrowright:{x:1,y:0},d:{x:1,y:0}
  };
  const m=map[k];
  if(m&&(m.x+dir.x!==0||m.y+dir.y!==0))nd=m;
});

init();loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
    body { margin: 0; height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #111; font-family: sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { background: #222; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #000; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c');
const x = c.getContext('2d');
const T = 20;
const S = 24;
let snake, food, dx, dy, score, loop, over, start;
let ip = false;

function init() {
    snake = [{x:12,y:12},{x:11,y:12},{x:10,y:12}];
    dx = 1; dy = 0;
    score = 0;
    over = false;
    start = true;
    placeFood();
    draw();
}

function placeFood() {
    let valid = false;
    while(!valid) {
        food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random()*S), y: Math.floor(Math.random()*S)};
        valid = !snake.some(s => s.x === food.x && s.y === food.y);
    }
}

function update() {
    if(start || over) return;
    ip = false;
    const h = {x: snake[0].x + dx, y: snake[0].y + dy};
    if(h.x < 0 || h.x >= S || h.y < 0 || h.y >= S || snake.some(s => s.x === h.x && s.y === h.y)) {
        over = true; draw(); return;
    }
    snake.unshift(h);
    if(h.x === food.x && h.y === food.y) { score += 10; placeFood(); }
    else { snake.pop(); }
    draw();
}

function draw() {
    x.fillStyle = '#222'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
    x.fillStyle = '#ff4757'; x.fillRect(food.x*T+2, food.y*T+2, T-4, T-4);
    x.fillStyle = '#2ed573'; 
    snake.forEach(s => x.fillRect(s.x*T+2, s.y*T+2, T-4, T-4));
    x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = '16px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 24);
    if(start) {
        x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
        x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = 'bold 30px sans-serif'; x.textAlign = 'center';
        x.fillText('CLICK TO START', 240, 240);
    }
    if(over) {
        x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
        x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif'; x.textAlign = 'center';
        x.fillText('GAME OVER', 240, 220);
        x.font = '20px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Score: '+score, 240, 260);
        x.font = '16px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Click to Restart', 240, 300);
    }
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if(start || over) return;
    if(ip) return;
    const k = e.key;
    if((k==='ArrowUp'||k==='w'||k==='W') && dy!==1) { dx=0; dy=-1; }
    else if((k==='ArrowDown'||k==='s'||k==='S') && dy!==-1) { dx=0; dy=1; }
    else if((k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='a'||k==='A') && dx!==1) { dx=-1; dy=0; }
    else if((k==='ArrowRight'||k==='d'||k==='D') && dx!==-1) { dx=1; dy=0; }
    ip = true;
});

c.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(over || start) {
        if(loop) clearInterval(loop);
        init();
        start = false;
        loop = setInterval(update, 100);
    }
});

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Flappy</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#1a1a2e;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
canvas{display:block;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d'),W=480,H=480;
const GRAV=.38,JUMP=-6.8,PIPE_W=52,GAP=130,PIPE_SPD=2.4,PIPE_INT=105;
const GROUND_H=60,BIRD_R=12,BIRD_X=80;

let bird,pipes,score,best=0,state,fc,groundX;
const init=()=>{bird={y:H/2,vy:0,rot:0};pipes=[];score=0;fc=0;groundX=0;state=0};
init();

const jump=()=>{if(state===0){state=1;bird.vy=JUMP}else if(state===1){bird.vy=JUMP}else{init();state=1;bird.vy=JUMP}};

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();jump()}});
c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();jump()});

const addPipe=()=>{const top=40+Math.random()*(H-GROUND_H-GAP-80);pipes.push({x:W,top,passed:false})};

const drawBird=(bx,by,rot)=>{
  x.save();x.translate(bx,by);x.rotate(rot);
  // body
  x.fillStyle='#f5c542';x.beginPath();x.ellipse(0,0,BIRD_R,BIRD_R*.85,0,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  // wing
  x.fillStyle='#e8a820';x.beginPath();x.ellipse(-4,2,8,5,-.2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  // eye
  x.fillStyle='#fff';x.beginPath();x.arc(5,-4,4.5,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#222';x.beginPath();x.arc(6.5,-4,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  // beak
  x.fillStyle='#e85040';x.beginPath();x.moveTo(BIRD_R-2,-2);x.lineTo(BIRD_R+7,1);x.lineTo(BIRD_R-2,4);x.closePath();x.fill();
  x.restore();
};

const drawPipe=(px,top)=>{
  const bot=top+GAP,botH=H-GROUND_H-bot;
  // top pipe
  const g1=x.createLinearGradient(px,0,px+PIPE_W,0);
  g1.addColorStop(0,'#2d6a4f');g1.addColorStop(.3,'#52b788');g1.addColorStop(.7,'#52b788');g1.addColorStop(1,'#2d6a4f');
  x.fillStyle=g1;x.fillRect(px,0,PIPE_W,top);
  x.fillStyle='#1b4332';x.fillRect(px-3,top-18,PIPE_W+6,18);
  x.fillStyle='#40916c';x.fillRect(px,top-16,PIPE_W,3);
  // bottom pipe
  x.fillStyle=g1;x.fillRect(px,bot,PIPE_W,botH);
  x.fillStyle='#1b4332';x.fillRect(px-3,bot,PIPE_W+6,18);
  x.fillStyle='#40916c';x.fillRect(px,bot+3,PIPE_W,3);
};

const drawGround=()=>{
  x.fillStyle='#c9a96e';x.fillRect(0,H-GROUND_H,W,GROUND_H);
  x.fillStyle='#b08c50';x.fillRect(0,H-GROUND_H,W,4);
  // stripes
  x.fillStyle='#d4b87a';
  for(let i=-1;i<W/20+2;i++){
    const sx=(i*20+groundX)%W-20;
    x.fillRect(sx,H-GROUND_H+12,12,3);
  }
};

const drawBg=()=>{
  const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H-GROUND_H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#0f3460');g.addColorStop(.5,'#16213e');g.addColorStop(1,'#1a1a2e');
  x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H-GROUND_H);
  // stars
  x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.35)';
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    const sx=(i*73+17)%W,sy=(i*47+11)%(H-GROUND_H-40),sr=.5+((i*31)%3)*.5;
    x.beginPath();x.arc(sx,sy,sr,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  }
  // moon
  x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,230,.12)';x.beginPath();x.arc(380,70,30,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,230,.2)';x.beginPath();x.arc(380,70,22,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
};

const collide=()=>{
  if(bird.y+BIRD_R>H-GROUND_H||bird.y-BIRD_R<0)return true;
  for(const p of pipes){
    if(BIRD_X+BIRD_R>p.x&&BIRD_X-BIRD_R<p.x+PIPE_W){
      if(bird.y-BIRD_R<p.top||bird.y+BIRD_R>p.top+GAP)return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

const update=()=>{
  if(state===1){
    bird.vy+=GRAV;bird.y+=bird.vy;
    bird.rot=Math.min(bird.vy*.06,1.2);
    groundX-=PIPE_SPD;
    fc++;
    if(fc%PIPE_INT===0)addPipe();
    for(const p of pipes){
      p.x-=PIPE_SPD;
      if(!p.passed&&p.x+PIPE_W<BIRD_X){p.passed=true;score++}
    }
    pipes=pipes.filter(p=>p.x>-PIPE_W-10);
    if(collide()){state=2;if(score>best)best=score}
  }else if(state===0){
    bird.y=H/2+Math.sin(Date.now()*.004)*8;bird.rot=0;
  }
};

const draw=()=>{
  drawBg();
  for(const p of pipes)drawPipe(p.x,p.top);
  drawGround();
  drawBird(BIRD_X,bird.y,bird.rot);

  // score
  x.textAlign='center';
  if(state===1||state===2){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';x.font='bold 48px sans-serif';
    x.fillText(score,W/2+2,72);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillText(score,W/2,70);
  }

  if(state===0){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.3)';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';x.font='bold 36px sans-serif';x.fillText('Flappy',W/2,180);
    x.font='16px sans-serif';x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)';
    x.fillText('Tap or press Space to play',W/2,220);
    drawBird(BIRD_X,bird.y,0);
  }

  if(state===2){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.45)';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    x.fillStyle='#e85040';x.font='bold 40px sans-serif';x.fillText('Game Over',W/2,180);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';x.font='bold 28px sans-serif';x.fillText('Score: '+score,W/2,230);
    x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.6)';x.font='18px sans-serif';x.fillText('Best: '+best,W/2,262);
    x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.5)';x.font='15px sans-serif';x.fillText('Tap or Space to restart',W/2,310);
  }
};

const loop=()=>{update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)};
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        body {
            margin: 0;

            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;

    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Game State
        let frames = 0;
        let score = 0;
        let gameState = 'START'; // START, PLAY, GAMEOVER

        // Constants
        const GRAVITY = 0.25;
        const JUMP = -4.6;
        const SPEED = 2;
        const GAP = 110;
        const GROUND_H = 20;

        // Entities
        const bird = {
            x: 50, y: 200, w: 24, h: 24, radius: 12, velocity: 0,
            draw: function() {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2);
                // Rotate based on velocity
                let rot = Math.min(Math.PI / 4, Math.max(-Math.PI / 4, (this.velocity * 0.1)));
                ctx.rotate(rot);
                
                // Body
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(0, 0, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Eye
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(6, -4, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(8, -4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Beak
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e67e22';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(8, 2);
                ctx.lineTo(16, 6);
                ctx.lineTo(8, 10);
                ctx.fill();
                
                ctx.restore();
            },
            update: function() {
                this.velocity += GRAVITY;
                this.y += this.velocity;

                // Floor Collision
                if (this.y + this.h >= canvas.height - GROUND_H) {
                    this.y = canvas.height - GROUND_H - this.h;
                    gameOver();
                }
                // Ceiling Collision
                if (this.y < 0) {
                    this.y = 0;
                    this.velocity = 0;
                }
            },
            jump: function() {
                this.velocity = JUMP;
            },
            reset: function() {
                this.y = 200;
                this.velocity = 0;
            }
        };

        const pipes = {
            items: [],
            w: 52,
            spawnRate: 130,
            draw: function() {
                for (let p of this.items) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71'; // Pipe Green
                    // Top Pipe
                    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, this.w, p.top);
                    // Bottom Pipe
                    ctx.fillRect(p.x, canvas.height - p.bottom, this.w, p.bottom);
                    
                    // Borders
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#27ae60';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.strokeRect(p.x, 0, this.w, p.top);
                    ctx.strokeRect(p.x, canvas.height - p.bottom, this.w, p.bottom);
                }
            },
            update: function() {
                if (frames % this.spawnRate === 0) {
                    // Calculate random heights
                    const minPipe = 40;
                    const maxTop = canvas.height - GROUND_H - GAP - minPipe;
                    const top = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxTop - minPipe + 1) + minPipe);
                    const bottom = canvas.height - GROUND_H - GAP - top;
                    this.items.push({ x: canvas.width, top: top, bottom: bottom, passed: false });
                }

                for (let i = 0; i < this.items.length; i++) {
                    let p = this.items[i];
                    p.x -= SPEED;

                    // Collision Detection
                    // Horizontal overlap
                    if (bird.x + bird.w > p.x && bird.x < p.x + this.w) {
                        // Vertical overlap (Top pipe OR Bottom pipe)
                        if (bird.y < p.top || bird.y + bird.h > canvas.height - p.bottom) {
                            gameOver();
                        }
                    }

                    // Score update
                    if (p.x + this.w < bird.x && !p.passed) {
                        score++;
                        p.passed = true;
                    }

                    // Remove off-screen
                    if (p.x + this.w < 0) {
                        this.items.shift();
                        i--;
                    }
                }
            },
            reset: function() {
                this.items = [];
            }
        };

        const ground = {
            x: 0,
            draw: function() {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ded895';
                ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - GROUND_H, canvas.width, GROUND_H);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#73bf2e';
                ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - GROUND_H, canvas.width, 4);
            }
        };

        // Input Handling
        function handleInput(e) {
            if (e.type === 'keydown' && e.code !== 'Space') return;
            if (e.type === 'touchstart') e.preventDefault();

            if (gameState === 'START') {
                gameState = 'PLAY';
                bird.jump();
            } else if (gameState === 'PLAY') {
                bird.jump();
            } else if (gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                resetGame();
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleInput);
        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handleInput);
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleInput, {passive: false});

        // Game Logic
        function gameOver() {
            gameState = 'GAMEOVER';
        }

        function resetGame() {
            bird.reset();
            pipes.reset();
            score = 0;
            frames = 0;
            gameState = 'START';
        }

        function drawText(text, subtext) {
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;

            if (text) {
                ctx.font = 'bold 50px sans-serif';
                ctx.strokeText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
            }
            if (subtext) {
                ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeText(subtext, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
                ctx.fillText(subtext, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
            }
        }

        // Main Loop
        function loop() {
            // Update
            if (gameState === 'PLAY') {
                bird.update();
                pipes.update();
                frames++;
            }

            // Draw
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Background decoration (clouds)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#a2d9e8';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(100, 80, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(140, 80, 40, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(350, 120, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

            pipes.draw();
            ground.draw();
            bird.draw();

            // UI
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            if (gameState === 'PLAY' || gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                ctx.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif';
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeText(score, canvas.width / 2, 80);
                ctx.fillText(score, canvas.width / 2, 80);
            }

            if (gameState === 'START') {
                drawText("FLAPPY", "Tap or Space to Start");
            } else if (gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                drawText("GAME OVER", "Score: " + score + " - Tap to Restart");
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }

        loop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
